name: obsidian-vault
description: Import Zotero literature into Obsidian, optionally parse PDFs with MinerU, and preserve stable literature notes.
shortDescription: Run a Zotero + MinerU + Obsidian literature pipeline.
longDescription: Provides a focused default MCP surface for importing Zotero items and collections into stable Obsidian literature notes, copying PDFs, preserving Zotero links and source paths, optionally parsing PDFs with MinerU, renaming extracted images with English semantic slugs, and generating jumpable MinerU image indexes. The broad legacy Obsidian toolbox for graph, wiki, Canvas, Bases, Dataview, schema, and CLI workflows remains available through the full or legacy tool profile.
defaultPrompt: Import this Zotero item into my Obsidian literature pipeline.
Parse this literature PDF with MinerU and generate an images index.
Batch import a Zotero collection without stopping on failures.
Check my pipeline config and local Zotero/MinerU readiness.
Run a dry-run migration to the focused literature pipeline layout.
